import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Robinson Crusoe Island (main island, ~33.64°S, 78.84°W)
robinson = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.84, -33.64]).buffer(2000)
# Santa Clara Island (smaller island, ~33.67°S, 78.92°W)
santa_clara = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.92, -33.67]).buffer(500)

date_start = '2018-11-01'
date_end = '2018-11-30'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
def mask_s2_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(cloud_mask)

col_robinson = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') \
    .filterBounds(robinson) \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

col_santa_clara = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') \
    .filterBounds(santa_clara) \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

size_rob = col_robinson.size().getInfo()
size_sc = col_santa_clara.size().getInfo()

print(f"Robinson Crusoe images: {size_rob}")
print(f"Santa Clara images: {size_sc}")

if size_rob == 0 or size_sc == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-2 data found for one or both islands.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Calculate NDVI
    def add_ndvi(image):
        ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
        return image.addBands(ndvi)
    
    col_robinson = col_robinson.map(add_ndvi)
    col_santa_clara = col_santa_clara.map(add_ndvi)
    
    # Median composite
    robinson_ndvi = col_robinson.select('NDVI').median()
    santa_clara_ndvi = col_santa_clara.select('NDVI').median()
    
    # 4. Check pixel counts
    count_rob = robinson_ndvi.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=robinson,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    count_sc = santa_clara_ndvi.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=santa_clara,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Robinson valid pixels: {count_rob}")
    print(f"Santa Clara valid pixels: {count_sc}")
    
    if count_rob == 0 or count_sc == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after cloud masking.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 5. Calculate mean NDVI
        ndvi_rob = robinson_ndvi.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=robinson,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
        
        ndvi_sc = santa_clara_ndvi.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=santa_clara,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Robinson Crusoe NDVI: {ndvi_rob:.4f}")
        print(f"Santa Clara NDVI: {ndvi_sc:.4f}")
        
        # 6. Validation & Final Answer
        if ndvi_rob is None or ndvi_sc is None or ndvi_rob < -1 or ndvi_rob > 1 or ndvi_sc < -1 or ndvi_sc > 1:
            print("Invalid NDVI calculation.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif ndvi_rob > ndvi_sc:
            print("Robinson Crusoe shows higher greenness.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Robinson Crusoe does not show higher greenness.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
